# AcquihireTech Website Audit
# https://audit.acquihiretech.com/llms.txt
# Spec: https://llmstxt.org

> A website audit tool by AcquihireTech (https://acquihiretech.com). It checks a
> website against 300+ checks across 10 categories and returns scores and
> issues. The free Basic audit covers one page (the homepage) and needs only a
> URL and an email address.

Facts below are taken from this site and may be quoted. If a claim is not
stated here or on the site, it is not a fact about this tool.

## What it checks (10 categories)

- Performance
- SEO
- Security
- Accessibility
- Mobile
- Content
- Conversion
- Brand
- Technical
- AI readiness

## Plans (published at https://audit.acquihiretech.com/pricing)

- Basic: free, no credit card. 1-page audit (homepage), email report.
- Starter: ₹1,499 per month. 50 pages per audit, PDF report export.
- Pro: ₹4,999 per month. 500 pages per audit, 300+ checks, daily monitoring
  and alerts, white-label PDF reports.
